newsitem.title: USA: U.S. states to announce small brokerage crackdown.
newsitem.headline: U.S. states to announce small brokerage crackdown.

text.p: State securities regulators were expected Thursday to announce a nationwide crackdown on the sales practices of small brokerages.
In the first of the planned announcements, New York State Attorney General Dennis Vacco's office said he would hold a news conference at 11 a.m. EDT/1500 GMT.

Vacco will be joined by representatives of the North American Securities Administrators Association, an umbrella group of securities regulators. At least one other state attorney general will also attend the briefing, a Vacco representative said.

In all, about 20 states are involved in the widespread initiative, according to the Securities Administrators Association, with a primary focus on telephone sales tactics used by small brokerages to attract small investors.
Another news conference was scheduled in Boston at 1 p.m. EDT/1700 GMT.
